body:
So I took 1 hit, and held it in for as long as I could.  I'm not quite sure how long I held it in, because time became very strange for me.  Pretty quickly everything around me started to almost melt into nothingness, like I was falling asleep.  And then I woke up, but not in this world, or universe or dimension.  So I started tearing myself out of the preveous exsistence I was in, and it was a very intense feeling, but not with any of the 5 senses I have, different ones, a sense of my entire existence.  There was a being there, and it conveyed to me that my entire reality and existence that I thought my entire life was made up of, wasn't real.  And I was now in the real existence.  I don't quite remember what I did while I was in the 'real' existence, but it felt like an entire lifetime, or almost infinity that I was there.  Then, BAM I wake up back into the real real world, confused wondering what the difference between those two existences were, and which was really real.
